title: Pan-genome-based resequencing of 2320 accessions reveals structural variations and accelerates breeding advances in cultivated peanut.

verified.what_i_actually_checked: Europe PMC record (PMID 42744999): not open access, no PMCID, no supplement, no text-mined accessions. NCBI elink from PubMed returned only related-PubMed links, no BioProject/SRA/GEO. BioProject esearch for peanut 2320/pan-genome/resequencing found 0 hits. Zenodo DOI search found 0 records; keyword searches found only lrcchina/Peanut-pangenome v1.0.0 (a 41 KB pipeline-code zip, README 'The pipeline of Peanut pan-genome', no data). Dryad search found 0. EurekAlert press release names no repository.
verified.what_came_from_paper_text_only: Everything about the data: 14-genome graph pan-genome, 2,320 genotyped accessions (88.03% of ICRISAT, 59.21% of USDA core germplasm), structural variant catalogue, flowering and dwarfism association results. Whether any phenotype table exists, and its size, is unknown; the data availability statement could not be read (paywalled).

a1_downloadable.note: No downloadable genotype matrix, structural variant (SV) set or phenotype table could be located: no NCBI links, no Zenodo/Dryad deposit on the DOI, only a 41 KB code zip. Data availability statement is paywalled; deposit may exist in a Chinese archive (CNGB/GSA) but was not found.

a2_label_is_a_column.note: Not checked in files. The natural labels (flowering time, plant height) would need a per-accession phenotype table; none located, and the abstract does not say one was released.

a3_inputs_present.note: Not verified. Inputs would be a 2,320-accession variant call file (VCF); only raw reads are typical for such deposits, which would require genotyping from scratch.

a4_units_stated.note: No phenotype file seen, so units unknown.

a5_enough_rows.note: Paper claims 2,320 accessions; phenotyped count unknown and unverified.

a6_fits_laptop.working_set: unknown; a filtered SNP/SV genotype matrix would be ~1-5 GB, raw reads tens of TB
a6_fits_laptop.note: Fits only if a processed, filtered genotype matrix is released; none found.

a7_counts_match_paper.note: No files to compare against the paper's 2,320.

a8_label_provenance.note: If phenotypes exist they would be field measurements (flowering time, height), not model output. Unverified.

backbone.name: none clear; DNA language models (e.g. AgroNT, a plant DNA language model) are not built for population genotype matrices

integration.partner_dataset: ICRISAT / USDA GRIN germplasm passport and trait evaluation data
integration.join_key: germplasm accession ID (PI / ICG numbers), not verified to be in any released file
integration.bigger_question_one_sentence: Do structural variants predict field traits across global peanut germplasm better than SNPs alone?

controls.positive_control: Recover the paper's reported flowering/dwarfism loci by association, if data were available.
controls.external_validation: USDA GRIN trait evaluations for overlapping accessions (unverified overlap).

honest_claim_h3: Predicts peanut flowering time or plant height from genome-wide SNP and structural-variant genotypes, among mostly gene-bank core accessions phenotyped in the authors' field trials; untestable because no data were found.

plain_idea.one_liner: Use whole-genome variant profiles of 2,320 peanut varieties to predict flowering time and plant height.
plain_idea.train_on: Per-accession genotypes at SNPs and structural variants from the pan-genome; number of usable phenotyped accessions unknown.
plain_idea.predict: Field-measured traits such as flowering time or plant height, assuming the authors released per-accession measurements (not confirmed).
plain_idea.why_worthwhile: Peanut breeders (ICRISAT, Chinese academies) would learn whether structural variants add predictive power over SNPs for genomic selection.

ml_idea: Genomic prediction (SNP + SV genotypes to trait) comparing GBLUP (a standard linear mixed-model baseline) against gradient boosting, testing whether SVs add accuracy. Blocked: no processed genotype or phenotype data located.

effort.compute_note: Not estimable: no data files located; a filtered genotype matrix for 2,320 lines would be CPU-feasible if released.
effort.cheapest_killing_check: Read the paper's data availability statement and confirm a processed VCF plus a per-accession phenotype table are publicly downloadable (not raw reads only).

verdict_reason: A1 fails: paywalled paper, no PMCID, no NCBI/Zenodo/Dryad deposit found beyond a 41 KB code zip, and no evidence of a released phenotype table. Likely raw reads only (if anywhere) plus a constructed label; revisit only if a processed VCF and trait table surface.
